_comment: The noise budget and the waiver list.
noiseBudget: how many findings of a P2/P3 rule this repo currently carries.
P2 and P3 never fail on presence — only when the count exceeds the number
here. That is what lets a hard gate be switched on in a codebase that
already has forty console warnings: 41 against a budget of 38 fails and
waivers: individual findings that are known and accepted for now. Each one
needs an owner and an expiresOn, and an expired waiver fails the run by
itself — nothing here can mute a problem forever by being forgotten.
Regenerate the budget from a clean run with:
